entries.keywords: photosynthesis plants make food sunlight leaves chlorophyll
entries.a: Photosynthesis is how green plants make their own food. Leaves take in sunlight, water (from the roots) and carbon dioxide (from the air) and make sugar and oxygen. Chlorophyll makes leaves green.

entries.keywords: water cycle evaporation condensation rain precipitation clouds
entries.a: The water cycle: the sun heats water and it evaporates, the vapour cools and forms clouds (condensation), and the water falls as rain (precipitation). Then it flows back to rivers and the sea.

entries.keywords: states of matter solid liquid gas melting freezing boiling
entries.a: Matter has three main states: solid (keeps its shape), liquid (flows) and gas (spreads out). Heating melts ice into water and boils water into steam.

entries.keywords: food chain producer consumer predator prey herbivore carnivore omnivore
entries.a: A food chain shows who eats whom. It starts with a producer (a plant), then a herbivore, then a carnivore. Example: grass → zebra → lion.

entries.keywords: parts of a plant roots stem leaf flower seed fruit
entries.a: Parts of a plant: roots (take in water), stem (holds the plant up), leaves (make food), flowers (make seeds) and fruit (holds the seeds).

entries.keywords: solar system planets sun earth mars jupiter saturn mercury venus uranus neptune
entries.a: There are 8 planets going away from the Sun: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune. Earth is the third. The Sun is a star.

entries.keywords: heart pumps blood circulation lungs breathe oxygen body organs
entries.a: The heart pumps blood around the body. The lungs take in oxygen when we breathe. The brain controls everything, and the stomach digests food.

entries.keywords: malaria mosquito prevent net bite disease
entries.a: Malaria is spread by the female Anopheles mosquito. Sleep under a treated net, remove standing water, and tell an adult quickly if you have fever so you can get to a clinic.

entries.keywords: gravity force pull falls weight newton earth
entries.a: Gravity is the force that pulls things towards the Earth. It is why a ball you drop falls down and why we stay on the ground.

entries.keywords: energy forms light heat sound electrical renewable solar power
entries.a: Energy comes in many forms: heat, light, sound, movement and electricity. Renewable energy like sunshine and water never runs out. Zimbabwe makes hydro power at Kariba.
